title: Miro board of reference games
about: Read with the Miro connector on 27 Nov 2026: 98 items, of which 14 texts (11 headings, 3 linked game names), 11 market notes on yellow stickies and 72 screenshots. Each heading names a game or a series and, in red, its provider; the sticky beside it gives the market as the board writes it. The screenshots were not opened.
